0.2!:p~@C{JqP`V;nQ5S.text: Previous outcome drove our decision.  Current outcome allows us to evaluate that decision.our decision is based on whether we win lose or draw.Our options are to go forward, backward, or stay.If we chose to go forward and that leads to a win, then we should do that again.If we chose to go forward, and that leads to a loss, then we should tend towards what would have won.If we chose to go forward and that leads to a tie, then we should tend towards what would have won.
